title: Primes, Factors and Factor Trees
summary: Every whole number is built from primes. Factor trees, prime factorisation, HCF and LCM.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 3: Finding Common Ground

objectives: I can find the prime factorisation of a number using a factor tree.
I can find the HCF and LCM using prime factors.
I can use HCF and LCM to solve real problems.
misconceptions: Different factor trees give different prime factors.
